concepts.name: Vault Door — refined desktop
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: refined high-fidelity web landing page design for Vault 443, not a photo of hardware, no browser chrome, no device mockup, edge-to-edge page.
Image roles: Image 1 is the USER-SELECTED "Vault Door Interface" visual concept and is the primary material, art-direction and visual-identity reference. Image 2 is the real Vault 443 application screenshot; preserve its actual window contents and aspect ratio as the product preview. Image 3 is the existing emblem; preserve its recognizable brass vault-door design.
Keep the approved concept's massive dark blue-grey industrial vault mechanism, aged brass edges, thick mechanical rings, recessed rectangular product viewport, pale 443 stencilling, restrained green pilot lamps, deep metal relief, dense Fallout 1–2 late-1990s pre-rendered interface character. This must look like the selected concept thoughtfully refined into a polished functional website, not a different theme or a generic modern landing page. Crisp typography, readable labels, practical controls. Original industrial artwork only.
Show the OPEN final resting state after a short entrance sequence: bolts have released and the central shutter has retracted to reveal the real app screenshot. The primary download control is outside the moving mechanism and always visible.
Exact short interface copy to use where appropriate: "VAULT 443", "A Linux VPN client", "Your profiles. Internet and work.", "DOWNLOAD FOR LINUX", "EXPLORE", "CONSOLE", "SCREENSHOTS", "DOWNLOAD", "EN / RU", "Ubuntu / Debian / Fedora / Arch", "DEMO PREVIEW". Feature labels below the hero: "YOUR PROFILES", "WORK NETWORKS", "DIAGNOSTICS".
IMPORTANT factual correction to Image 1: the ONLY SIX protocol plate labels are exactly "VLESS", "TROJAN", "OUTLINE", "OPENVPN", "WIREGUARD", "AMNEZIAWG". There must be NO VMESS, HYSTERIA or IKEv2. Status describes a DEMO PREVIEW, not a real browser VPN connection. Do not invent numerical speed, latency or security claims. Do not add body paragraphs of tiny fake text. Essential copy is clean and legible against the textures.
Composition: DESKTOP landscape 16:10, roughly a 1440px-wide browser viewport. Preserve the selected concept's layout: compact metal masthead with recognizable emblem/VAULT 443 on the left, three metal navigation keys and EN / RU to the right. Hero has a large but purposeful 443 stencil and short product copy on the left, a prominent broad brass DOWNLOAD FOR LINUX pushplate and smaller EXPLORE key, and a monumental near-circular vault assembly occupying the larger right region. Show the real screenshot cleanly centered in the door's recessed rectangular aperture. Distribute the six accurate engraved protocol plates around the ring, three on each side, with small green lamps. The aperture should be large enough for the screenshot to read as a real product, not a tiny thumbnail. Engineering structure connects all parts; screws, rim, hydraulic sleeve, hinges, slots and warning marks are deliberate, not random clutter. Below the hero a thin demo-status rail and the beginning of three substantial metal feature sections, not detached rounded cards. Polish optical alignment, simplify noisy surfaces behind copy, and preserve the striking heavy-machine atmosphere. No perspective distortion of the screenshot. Deliver one complete desktop website mockup.
